outcome: Frequency of postpartum stress urinary incontinence (SUI)
cohort: 286 healthy nulliparous women in the third trimester of pregnancy without prepregnancy urinary incontinence
finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a twofold increased risk of postpartum SUI compared to elective cesarean section, with age and birth weight identified as main risk factors for both modes of delivery.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a twofold increased risk of postpartum SUI in primipara women compared with elective cesarean section.
birth_weight: Positively correlated with increased frequency of postpartum SUI in both vaginal delivery and cesarean section groups
